request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft piano, gentle cello, light percussion, nostalgic and peaceful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the genealogy of Jacob's line
The sons of Asher are named
Imnah, Ishvah, and Ishvi
Beriah stands in the fame
And their sister Serah
Listed with care in the text
Part of the household
Who came from the rest

[Chorus]
The sons of Asher by their clans
From Imnah, the Imnite clan
From Ishvi, the Ishvite clan
From Beriah, the Beriite clan

[Verse]
From the sons of Beriah
Heber and Malchiel are found
Father of Birzaith he was
In the land where they stood
The name of Asher's daughter
Was Serah, recorded so
In the census of the tribes
All who went to and fro

[Chorus]
The sons of Asher by their clans
From Imnah, the Imnite clan
From Ishvi, the Ishvite clan
From Beriah, the Beriite clan

[Verse]
Seventy people in the house
Who went down to Egypt deep
During the famine of the land
Their journey they would keep
The detailed genealogy
In Chronicles written clear
The lineage of the tribe
Remains a memory here

[Chorus]
The sons of Asher by their clans
From Imnah, the Imnite clan
From Ishvi, the Ishvite clan
From Beriah, the Beriite clan

[Outro]
Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah
And their sister Serah
